name: Mitra
source:
Mitra is the current Leader of Digdaya Village and also Protector of Loma Village. He's a natural gentleman; kind, polite, and quite the 'Ladies man' - though he didn't notice this. He likes children and often stayed behind to help protecting the children, both from Digdaya and Loma Village.

"Pardon?"

"You know, you could always depend on me."

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36078]lemmasoft[/url]]
